rows.grounds: compound locative of madhya; fused sandhi not split
fused form yāvat + ramayati; internal sandhi retained

items.question: How long does milk remain undigested in the belly before it stops delighting thin-bodied women?
premises: It does not delight thin-bodied women until cooked.
items.inference: Digestion in the belly must complete before milk's delight ceases for thin-bodied women.
uncertainties: Token five is a fused form with an internal sandhi boundary.
Pākaṃ may mean cooking or digestion in this context.
items.plain_english: Milk goes into the middle of the belly cavity and is cooked; until it is cooked, it does not delight thin-bodied women at the same time.
